{"story":{"what":"Every T4 template the MessagePack source generator uses to emit types now writes [global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] inside an #if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK guard. The templates covered are the object formatter, string-key formatter, enum, union, resolver and composite resolver; for the resolvers the attribute also goes on the nested FormatterCache<T> and GetFormatterHelper classes. Each .tt template and its checked-in .cs output were edited the same way. TransformUtilities now ends the opening brace of a nesting type that has constraints with a line break, so the #if that follows starts on its own line. A new test class runs the generator and checks that every generated file has the attribute and that every occurrence sits inside the guard.
